data.name: Manhiyyah
data.gender_notes: Manhiyyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the root 'n-h-y' which means to support, help, or assist. In Islamic context, Manhiyyah refers to someone who provides emotional, spiritual, or material support. The name Manhiyyah carries the meaning “Support, Aid, Assistance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manhiyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody support, aid, assistance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes compassion, empathy, and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Manhiyyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Support, Aid, Assistance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manhiyyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
